tagline.en: UK MNO (now merged with Vodafone UK) — CS-only £7/£8 budget monthly plans
tagline.zh: 英国实体运营商（已与沃达丰英国合并）——7/8镑便宜月付需找客服开通

description.en: Three is a UK mobile network operator with its own 4G/5G infrastructure (99% population 4G coverage claim), merged with Vodafone UK. Public eSIM pricing starts around £10/60GB a month; the cheaper £7 (unlimited calls/texts + 3GB) and £8 (unlimited calls/texts + 8GB) monthly plans exist only via customer service. Any usage within 180 days keeps a PAYG number alive.
description.zh: Three是拥有自有4G/5G网络设施的英国实体运营商（宣称4G覆盖99%人口），已与Vodafone英国完成合并。公开渠道最划算的eSIM套餐约60GB/10英镑/月；更便宜的7英镑（无限通话短信+3GB）与8英镑（无限通话短信+8GB）月付仅客服渠道可办。Paygo号码每180天内有一次任意金额消费即可保号。

details.en: Three matters here as one of the four UK MNOs: its merger with Vodafone UK is completed, reshaping the UK market, and its network hosts iD Mobile as MVNO. For eSIM buyers the quirk is channel-based pricing: the storefront's best PAYG deal is £10/month for 60GB, while CS-only monthly plans at £7 (unlimited calls/texts, 3GB) and £8 (unlimited calls/texts, 8GB) are not published — you must chat with customer service to order them. Account login needs a Three UK number besides email/password. Keep-alive for PAYG numbers: one charged event of any amount (an SMS or a call both count) per 180 days. Best suited to users physically in the UK/EU wanting big data on a top-tier network; the source review flags Three for heavy UK/EU data users rather than China-roaming cloud residents, and notes remote-area coverage as its weak spot.
details.zh: Three的价值在于它是英国四大实体运营商之一：与Vodafone英国的合并已完成，重塑英国市场格局，iD Mobile作为虚商挂在其网络上。对eSIM买家而言特别之处是渠道定价：官网最划算的Paygo是60GB/10英镑/月，而7英镑（无限通话短信+3GB）与8英镑（无限通话短信+8GB）的月付官网不挂出，必须找人工客服才能办理。账户登录除邮箱密码外还需一个Three UK号码。Paygo保号：每180天内一次任意金额计费（发条短信或打个电话都算）。最适合人在英国/欧盟、想要一线网络大流量的用户；源盘点认为Three适合英国与欧盟大流量需求者而非中国漫游云居民，并指出偏远地区覆盖是其弱项。

bestFor.en: Heavy UK/EU data users who don't mind contacting CS to unlock the cheaper monthly plans.
bestFor.zh: 英国/欧盟本地大流量用户，不介意找客服解锁更便宜的月付套餐。

en: UK MNO with own 4G/5G network (99% pop 4G claim)
PAYG keep-alive: one charged event per 180 days
zh: 英国实体运营商，自有4G/5G网络（宣称4G覆盖99%人口）
客服专享低价月付：7英镑/3GB、8英镑/8GB
Paygo保号：每180天一次任意计费

plansNote.en: CS-only plans are not published on the storefront — pricing per the 2026-03 source review of CS conversations.
plansNote.zh: 客服专享套餐官网不挂出，价格来自2026-03盘点对客服对话的整理。

en: Own-network MNO quality, no MVNO priority penalty
£7–£8 CS monthly plans undercut the storefront
Relaxed PAYG keep-alive (any charged event / 180 days)
zh: 自有网络MNO质量，无虚商优先级惩罚
Paygo保号宽松（180天内任意计费即可）

en: Cheapest plans hidden behind CS chat
Login requires an existing Three UK number
Weaker remote-area coverage; not China-roaming oriented
zh: 最便宜套餐藏在客服对话里
账户登录需要已有Three UK号码
偏远地区覆盖较弱；非中国漫游导向
